## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. VXX falling (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) confirm risk appetite, with HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.35%) ABOVE TREND as a secondary confirmation.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Commodity/energy strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) and BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND fueling cyclicals. Fear easing: VXX ↓ falling (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION and Stocks vs Bonds ↑ rising (1W: +1.48% | 1M: -2.23%) RECOVERY supporting flow into equities; monitor credit where HYG/LQD small gains may mask regime signal.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-slightly tightening: UUP rising (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -0.22%) RECOVERY, TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +2.80%) → flat, and the yield-curve showing mild flattening (Level 1.0774, 1W: -0.26%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Cyclicals/energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) and XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%); Utilities also strong: XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +7.69%). Tech mixed: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) — style: cyclicals/energy over pure growth.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US marginally outperforming: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%); EM catch-up: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +7.00%). Japan showing short-term pullback: EWJ CORRECTION (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +7.89%), China FXI RECOVERY (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -1.35%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation mixed but present: IWM RECOVERY (1W: +1.95% | 1M: -1.19%) and ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +4.44% | 1M: -10.96%) with IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -24.83%) — speculative flows exist but 1M weakness limits conviction.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Commodity and metals strength: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.86% | 1M: +1.37%) and SLV RECOVERY (1W: +13.13% | 1M: -8.74%); gold supportive: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.82% | 1M: +5.64%).

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy strong: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%); natural gas weak: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Broad sector participation (9/11) and XLE/XLU/XLB ABOVE TREND confirm cyclical breadth. DIVERGENCE: XLK and QQQ in RECOVERY (1W positive, 1M negative) and VXX CORRECTION constitute a MINOR divergence — monitor for momentum fade.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor cyclicals/energy exposure (XLE, XLB) and selective EM exposure (EEM); reduce exposure to high-duration tech beta (XLK) while keeping bonds neutral (TLT ABOVE TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%), TAN ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +14.39%) — watch energy/solar strength.  
BEARISH: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) — watch for tech momentum fade; UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) on weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +10.24%).  
BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) — downside pressure in nat gas.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) — current VXX (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION; HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot) — HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.35%) ABOVE TREND; SPY/TLT ~7.71 (current Stocks vs Bonds level 7.7109, 1W: +1.48%) RECOVERY.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON — Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, broad cyclical participation.  
Energy and cyclicals showing strength (XLE ABOVE TREND, XLB ABOVE TREND) while tech is mixed (XLK RECOVERY).  
Key risk: minor divergence in tech (1W/1M mismatch) and watch credit spreads/HYG-LQD for signs credit stress re-emerging.
